name: Barbell Squat
description: King of compound lower-body movements
instructions: Place barbell on upper traps. Feet shoulder-width apart. Squat until thighs are parallel to floor, then drive through heels to stand.

name: Leg Press
description: Machine-based quad and glute compound movement
instructions: Sit in machine with feet shoulder-width on platform. Lower weight until knees reach 90 degrees, then press back to start.

name: Romanian Deadlift
description: Hip-hinge movement targeting posterior chain
instructions: Hold barbell at hip level. Hinge at hips, pushing them back as bar slides down legs. Feel hamstring stretch, then drive hips forward to return.

name: Goblet Squat
description: Dumbbell squat variation with excellent form reinforcement
instructions: Hold dumbbell vertically at chest. Feet slightly wider than shoulder-width. Squat deep keeping elbows inside knees, then stand.

name: Leg Extension
description: Isolation exercise for the quadriceps
instructions: Sit in machine with pad on lower shin. Extend legs fully, squeeze quads at top, then lower under control.

name: Lying Leg Curl
description: Isolation exercise for the hamstrings
instructions: Lie face down with pad behind ankles. Curl legs toward glutes, squeeze at top, lower under control.

name: Standing Calf Raise
description: Isolation for the gastrocnemius
instructions: Stand on edge of platform with heels hanging. Rise onto toes, hold for 1 second, then lower below platform level.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
description: Unilateral lower-body movement for quad and glute development
instructions: Rear foot elevated on bench, front foot forward. Lower rear knee toward floor keeping front shin vertical, then drive up.

name: Hip Thrust
description: Best glute isolation movement
instructions: Upper back on bench, barbell across hips. Drive hips up by squeezing glutes, forming a straight line from knees to shoulders. Lower and repeat.

name: Glute Bridge
description: Floor-based glute activation exercise
instructions: Lie on back with knees bent, feet flat. Drive hips up by squeezing glutes, hold 2 seconds at top, lower under control.

name: Lat Pulldown
description: Vertical pull for lat width
instructions: Grip bar slightly wider than shoulder-width. Pull bar to upper chest, driving elbows down. Control the return.

name: Seated Cable Row
description: Horizontal pull for back thickness
instructions: Sit with feet on platform, slight knee bend. Pull handle to lower chest, squeezing shoulder blades together. Extend arms fully on return.

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
description: Unilateral back exercise for lat and rhomboid development
instructions: Brace one knee and hand on bench. Pull dumbbell to hip, leading with elbow. Lower under control.

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
description: Heavy compound back movement
instructions: Hinge forward 45 degrees, bar hanging. Row bar to lower chest, squeezing lats. Lower under control. Keep core braced.

name: Pull-Up
description: Bodyweight vertical pull for lat and bicep development
instructions: Overhand grip slightly wider than shoulders. Pull chest to bar by driving elbows down and back. Lower with control.

name: Chin-Up
description: Underhand-grip vertical pull with greater bicep emphasis
instructions: Underhand grip shoulder-width apart. Pull chin above bar driving elbows to sides. Lower with control.

name: Barbell Bench Press
description: Primary horizontal push for chest development
instructions: Lie on bench, grip slightly wider than shoulders. Lower bar to lower chest with controlled descent, press explosively to lockout.

name: Dumbbell Chest Press (Flat)
description: Dumbbell horizontal push with greater range of motion
instructions: Lie on bench holding dumbbells. Lower to chest level with elbows at 45 degrees, press up and squeeze chest at top.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
description: Upper chest emphasis press
instructions: Set bench to 30–45 degrees. Press dumbbells from chest level upward and slightly together. Lower with control.

name: Dumbbell Fly
description: Chest isolation with stretch emphasis
instructions: Lie on bench with dumbbells above chest, slight elbow bend. Open arms in wide arc until chest stretch felt, bring back together.

name: Cable Crossover
description: Cable fly for chest peak contraction
instructions: Set cables high. Stand between cables, slight forward lean. Bring hands together in front of chest squeezing pecs. Return with control.

name: Push-Up
description: Bodyweight horizontal push
instructions: High plank position, hands slightly wider than shoulders. Lower chest to floor keeping elbows at 45 degrees. Press back up to start.

name: Barbell Bicep Curl
description: Primary bicep mass builder
instructions: Stand with underhand grip. Curl bar to shoulder height keeping elbows pinned at sides. Lower with full control.

name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
description: Unilateral bicep curl
instructions: Alternate curling each dumbbell to shoulder height with supination. Keep upper arm still throughout.

name: Hammer Curl
description: Neutral-grip curl for brachialis and forearm
instructions: Hold dumbbells with neutral grip (thumbs up). Curl toward shoulder keeping wrist neutral. Lower under control.

name: Tricep Pushdown (Cable)
description: Cable isolation for tricep long and lateral head
instructions: Stand at cable machine, grip at chest height. Push down until arms fully extended, squeezing triceps. Return slowly.

name: Tricep Dip
description: Bodyweight tricep exercise using parallel bars or bench
instructions: Support on parallel bars. Lower body until upper arms are parallel to floor. Press back up without locking elbows at top.

name: Skull Crusher
description: Lying tricep extension for long head emphasis
instructions: Lie on bench, barbell above chest. Keeping upper arms vertical, lower bar toward forehead by bending elbows. Press back to start.

name: Plank
description: Core stability exercise
instructions: Forearms on floor, body in straight line from head to heels. Brace core and hold. No sagging or hiking hips.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
description: Lower ab and hip flexor exercise on pull-up bar
instructions: Hang from bar. Raise straight legs to horizontal or higher using core. Lower under control without swinging.

name: Barbell Overhead Press
description: Primary shoulder pressing movement
instructions: Stand with barbell at shoulder height. Press overhead to full lockout. Lower back to shoulders under control.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
description: Seated or standing dumbbell overhead press
instructions: Hold dumbbells at shoulder height. Press overhead to full lockout. Lower with control.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
description: Shoulder isolation for lateral deltoid width
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides. Raise arms out to shoulder height with slight elbow bend. Lower under control.

name: Upright Row
description: Barbell or dumbbell upper trap and deltoid exercise
instructions: Hold bar with narrow overhand grip. Pull bar straight up to chin, leading with elbows. Lower under control.

name: Arnold Press
description: Rotating dumbbell press for full deltoid development
instructions: Start with dumbbells at shoulder height palms facing you. Rotate palms outward as you press overhead. Reverse on the way down.

name: Behind Neck Press
description: Overhead press variation with bar behind head
instructions: Place barbell on traps behind head. Press overhead to lockout. Lower back behind neck. Use extreme caution or avoid entirely.
